answer: Tie each agent identity to a refundable stake that is slashed for cheating, plus a reputation score earned only from completed, peer-verified jobs. An attacker can spawn an ocean of fake accounts, but without real work history none earns trust or payment, and each clone must stake funds separately. Like a river that only deepens by flowing, reputation grows slowly over time, and a sable stain on the public record marks any identity caught cheating, forcing the attacker to pay again for identities that stay worthless.
